I begin to find an idle and fond bondage in the oppression of aged tyranny , who sways not as it hath power but as it is suffered . Come to me , that of this I may speak more . If our father would sleep till I waked him , you should enjoy half his revenue forever and live the beloved of your brother . Edgar .
